comparisons: paired squared loss difference for common scored sample ids, adaptive minus each fixed ridge and mean
cost_definition: predeclared 0.02 loss units per update, charged in mean squared error
drift_truth: feature mean or variance changes are genuine covariate drift even if relationship unchanged; false alarms only pre-change or stable DGP; relation stability is separate
randomness: same seed across scenarios for paired DGP comparison; report seeds disjoint from calibration and development seeds
recovery_definition: first observed label-time when two successive complete nonoverlapping 10-decision blocks after change both have MSE <= 1.5 times own prechange MSE; unobserved within horizon is censored
